canon: Fauna de 120-180 cm, tipo gacela, con cuernos finos y largos de cabra montesa (sin apenas espiral), cuello ancho y pelaje muy corto, rojo por arriba y blanco por el vientre. Come pasto y hojas altas gracias al cuello largo. Vive en manada. Las hembras llevan más rojo que los machos y cuernos más anchos.

prompt.sujeto: A tall, slender herd grazer with a very long, upright neck and long, thin legs, its small head held far above an adult orc.
prompt.cuerpo: Its small, deer-like head has large dark eyes and a short tuft of beard. The very short coat is rust red along the back and neck and creamy white on the belly, throat and inner legs.
rasgos: Two wide, flat horns shaped like broad leaves spread out sideways from the top of its head, pale bone grey and veined like real leaves.
Each long leg ends in a large splayed foot of three clawed toes, like a big bird's.
prompt.pose: It stands in the centre of the foreground facing the viewer with its head held high, while the rest of the herd grazes and wanders around it.
prompt.entorno: Around them lies red desert earth with dry scrub and tufts of pale grass, with red sandstone mesas and spires in the distance.
prompt.luz: Clear daylight under a blue sky with scattered white clouds.

rasgos+: This male has the larger, wider-spreading leaf horns of the herd.
This female has a deeper red coat and shorter, broader leaf horns.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore
choca con el canon: cuernos de hoja (el canon: finos y largos de cabra montesa), pies de ave de tres dedos, cuello de jirafa
